summary: Completed frontend testing of the redesigned Integrations page with 3 provider cards (Discord, Telegram, Zendesk). All 6 features tested and working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Integrations page correctly shows 3 provider cards (Discord, Telegram, Zendesk) in a responsive grid layout
Each card displays status badge (Active/Paused/Connect) and response mode info for connected providers
Discord detail view has proper two-column layout: left (Connect to Discord card with server info + Disconnect button), right (Bot Status, Configuration, Listen Mode cards)
Discord App Setup banner links to /admin/accounts/discord for global app credentials
Listen Mode buttons (Mention Only, All Channels, Specific Channels) are clickable and update the mode
Telegram and Zendesk have simpler single-column views with Connection card and Response Mode badge
Back to Integrations button works correctly from all detail views
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing API Tester bot with connections for all 3 providers
context_for_next_testing_agent: Integrations page redesign fully tested. Key data-testid attributes: provider-card-discord, provider-card-telegram, provider-card-zendesk, back-to-integrations, discord-detail-view, telegram-detail-view, zendesk-detail-view, discord-bot-status-card, discord-config-card, discord-listen-mode-card, listen-mode-mention_only, listen-mode-all_channels, listen-mode-specific_channels. Bot 'API Tester' has connections for all 3 providers.

features_tested.details: Banner at top of Discord detail view with 'Open' link to /admin/accounts/discord.

features_tested.feature: Zendesk card opens detail view with connection info and response mode
features_tested.details: Shows Connection card with subdomain (midnight-gd.zendesk.com), active status, Disable button, and Response Mode badge (Internal Note).

features_tested.feature: Telegram card opens detail view with connection info and response mode
features_tested.details: Shows Connection card with bot status (paused), Enable button, and Response Mode badge (Auto-Reply).

features_tested.feature: Back to Integrations button returns to 3-card grid from any detail view
features_tested.details: Button works correctly from Discord, Telegram, and Zendesk detail views.

features_tested.feature: Listen Mode buttons on Discord detail view are clickable
features_tested.details: All 3 buttons (Mention Only, All Channels, Specific Channels) are clickable and switch the listen mode.
